Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the
intersection in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: Sorry, I'm not comfortable giving my name on a recording yet. You can refer to me as the claimant.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were coimng from and where you were headed when the collision
happened?
A: I was driving through the intersection heading straight. The light had been green when I first saw it from a block
back, so I kept my speed steady.
Q: Which direction was the other vehicle traveling?
A: It came from my right side, crossing my path. I never saw it until it was almost on top of me. I tried to brake, but
there wasn't time to stop.
Q: Did you notice the signal for your direction at the moment of impact?
A: I believe it was still green for me. I'm fairly sure of that, although the other driver may have been coming through on
a yellow or a red. I can't say for certain.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The airbag deployed on my side and I hit my arm against the door frame and the steering wheel as I
tried to catch myself.
Q: Can you tell me about your injuries?
A: My left wrist was badly hurt. The emergency room took X-rays and told me it was fractured. I've been in a cast
since then and I have follow-up visits scheduled with a hand specialist. My neck is also sore, but the wrist is the main
problem right now.
Q: Did you receive any treatment at the scene?
A: Paramedics checked me over and I was taken to the hospital by ambulance. I didn't refuse any care.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want the record to show I was driving carefully and I'm still dealing with the pain and the limits this injury
has put on my work.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
